scope: Greece medical discovery — University of Crete International Program in Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Crete offers a six-year English-taught International Program in Medicine for international students.
Applicants require a qualifying foreign secondary certificate and English B2, TOEFL 79 or IELTS 6.5; the first-semester payment for newly admitted students is EUR 6,000.
The curriculum is taught in English and includes clinical clerkships structured after Internal Medicine and Surgery.
